subject: Aligning stakeholders & success roadmap (Novara Health)
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
To: Julia Kramer <jkramer@novarahealth.com>, Toby Lin <toby.lin@novarahealth.com>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 4 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Intro + proposed success roadmap and quick kickoff

Hi Julia — great to meet you over email. I’m Aditya (AE on the Novara opportunity). Thanks for the time last week — we’d like to get an initial mutual plan in place so we can align stakeholders, success criteria, and a realistic close timeline.

High-level proposal:
- Goal: 6–8 week evaluation to validate inference latency + cost targets on a representative workload and a pilot integration into your staging environment.
- Success criteria: <5 99th-ms latency on 2xA100-equivalent and cost-per-inference within target range (we’ll refine with your workload).
- Proposed timeline: kickoff this week, week 2: short integration test, week 4: eval metrics review, week 6: exec review + procurement.

Would you and Toby be able to join a 45-minute kickoff to align stakeholders and confirm the MAP? I’m available:
- Tue 5/5 10:00–11:00 PT
- Wed 5/6 09:00–11:30 PT

I’m attaching a short draft MAP (one page) that we can use as the working doc. If you can share the internal stakeholders who should be in the loop (security, procurement, dev lead), I’ll make sure we invite the right folks.

Attachment: MAP_Draft_Novara_v1.xlsx (xlsx, 48KB)

Quick agenda I suggest for kickoff:
1) Introductions & roles (10m)
2) Success criteria and data/sample workload (10m)
3) Integration/infra plan and timeline (15m)
4) Next steps and owners (10m)

Thanks — looking forward to aligning.

—
Aditya Rao
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0124
From: Julia Kramer <jkramer@novarahealth.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: Toby Lin <toby.lin@novarahealth.com>, procurement@novarahealth.com
Date: Mon, 4 May 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro + proposed success roadmap and quick kickoff

Thanks Aditya — this looks good and close to what we had in mind. I’ll be the product champion for the evaluation and Toby will run procurement. Please also include our infrastructure lead, Sara Wong (sara.wong@novarahealth.com), and I’ve looped in procurement above.

Kickoff availability works best for Tue 5/5 at 10:00 PT — can you send a calendar invite?

A couple of notes up front:
- Procurement will want a high-level SOW and a short security summary (SOC 2 / data residency notes). Can you bring an initial SOW and the standard security checklist to the kickoff?
- Our primary success check will be integration into a staging API and a run of the sample dataset (we can share the data schema ahead of time).

Julia
Director, Data Products
Novara Health

Quick internal note — thanks for moving fast on this. A few asks before the kickoff:
1) Roles: I will lead onboarding and post-eval success; Marissa, please own the customer success plan and run the eval checklist during week 2–4. Ethan, can you prepare a short slide on infra integration constraints (networking, sample payload sizes, expected KV cache behavior) for Tuesday’s call?
2) Pricing: Aditya, surface two pricing buckets in the call: pilot (short-term eval with hosted tokens) and pilot→prod (discounted reserved for Dedicated). We’ll need a rough ballpark for procurement to avoid surprises.
3) Security: bring the SOC 2 / data residency statement (Aditya already attached an initial QA pdf — good). If procurement pushes for more, we’ll escalate to Vivek.

I’ll own follow-ups and the mutual action plan doc after the call.

Mina
